title: Height difference h
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the height difference between points D and A as 20 m.

title: Time to inclined plane
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly determine the time from the camera's release at E to being caught on the slope as 2 s.

title: Xiao Ming's acceleration magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the magnitude of Xiao Ming's constant acceleration down the slope as 2.5 m/s².

title: Drone's upward acceleration
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply Newton's second law to find the drone's upward acceleration (a₁ = g = 10 m/s²) from the given lift force.

title: Camera's projectile motion analysis
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly set up the horizontal (x = v₀t) and vertical (y = ½gt²) kinematic equations for the camera's motion from point E.

title: Geometry of impact point
description: Important Criteria: The student must relate the camera's horizontal and vertical displacements to the slope using trigonometry (tanθ = (y - h)/x), where h is the height difference between E and D.

title: Xiao Ming's displacement relation
description: Important Criteria: The student must relate Xiao Ming's displacement down the slope (s = x/cosθ) to his constant acceleration kinematics (s = ½at²).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student incorrectly handles signs in the vertical motion equation or misinterprets the geometry of the impact point relative to the slope.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student maintains consistent units (m, s, m/s²) throughout the solution and includes them in final answers.
